name: Prism ◇ Recollection!
original_name: プリズム◇リコレクション！
source:
In the year 2040, there have been considerable technological advances, especially in city centers like Tonan. One day in late August, Masanobu returned to his hometown after being away in Tokyo for about 3 years and transferred into Kujougaoka Gakuen. After meeting Sayaka and getting a short tour of the city, he later joined her club, ☆☆☆ Club (Three Stars Club). Its primary function is to guide tourists and it is pretty well known both within and outside of the school. He got to know Sayaka and fellow club member Hinano well, and his classmate Aina and imouto Konoka also joined the club which became an oasis to him.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
2040年，科技取得了长足进步，在图南这样的城市中心尤其如此。八月下旬，久我山昌信离开故乡、在东京生活约三年后归来，并转入九条丘学园。与连城纱耶香相遇、在她带领下简单游览城市后，昌信加入了纱耶香所属的“☆☆☆部”（三星部）。社团的主要活动是为游客提供向导服务，在校内外都颇有名气。他逐渐与纱耶香和另一名社员初咲雏乃熟识；同班同学艾娜与妹妹久我山木乃香也加入社团。这里由此成为昌信心中的绿洲。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/02/01/february-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
